title: Rosemary Bespoke | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled in the heart of Rosemary Beach Town Center, this extraordinary seven-bedroom, seven-and-a-half-bathroom condo home redefines luxury beach living. Spanning 6,500 square feet over five meticulously designed levels, the residence boasts a private pool, a residential elevator, and breathtaking birds-eye views of the Gulf from a 1,000 square foot rooftop terrace. Each of the five king bedrooms and two bunk rooms is a sanctuary of comfort, featuring plush linens and spacious spa-inspired ensuite baths. The grand primary suite offers dual private bathrooms, a sitting room, and a balcony overlooking the vibrant town center, providing a serene escape within the home. The second level is a culinary haven with a state-of-the-art kitchen anchored by a 30-foot waterfall-edged island, perfect for hosting gourmet dinners. Dual living spaces with stunning finishes like wire brushed white oak flooring and Taj Mahal Quartzite countertops open up to balconies, enhancing the indoor-outdoor living experience. Ascend to the rooftop terrace to witness awe-inspiring sunrises and sunsets over the Gulf, complemented by a wet bar and lounge seating. Just a short stroll from the beach gates, this residence offers the perfect blend of elegance, convenience, and unparalleled coastal views, promising an unforgettable stay for up to 18 guests.
